pli-tv-bu-vb-np29:1.1.1: Tena samayena buddho bhagavā Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati Jetavane Anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np29:1.1.2: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū vutthavassā āraññakesu senāsanesu viharanti,
pli-tv-bu-vb-np29:1.1.6: atha kho bhagavā etasmiṃ nidāne dhammiṃ kathaṃ katvā bhikkhū āmantesi:
pli-tv-bu-vb-np29:1.1.7: anujānāmi bhikkhave āraññakesu senāsanesu viharantena tiṇṇaṃ cīvarānaṃ aññataraṃ cīvaraṃ antaraghare nikkhipitun ti. ||1||
pli-tv-bu-vb-np29:1.2.1: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū bhagavatā anuññātaṃ āraññakesu senāsanesu viharantena tiṇṇaṃ cīvarānaṃ aññataraṃ cīvaraṃ antaraghare nikkhipitun ti, te tiṇṇaṃ cīvarānaṃ aññataraṃ cīvaraṃ antaraghare nikkhipitvā atirekachārattaṃ vippavasanti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np29:1.2.2: tāni cīvarāni nassanti pi vinassanti pi ḍayhanti pi undurehi pi khajjanti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np29:1.2.6: atha kho te bhikkhū bhikkhūnaṃ etam atthaṃ ārocesuṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np29:1.2.7: ye te bhikkhū appicchā te . . . vipācenti:
pli-tv-bu-vb-np29:1.2.8: kathaṃ hi nāma bhikkhū tiṇṇaṃ cīvarānaṃ aññataraṃ cīvaraṃ antaraghare nikkhipitvā atirekachārattaṃ vippavasissantīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np29:1.2.9: atha kho te bhikkhū bhagavato etam atthaṃ ārocesuṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np29:1.2.10: saccaṃ kira bhikkhave bhikkhū tiṇṇaṃ cīvarānaṃ aññataraṃ cīvaraṃ antaraghare nikkhipitvā atirekachārattaṃ vippavasantīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np29:1.2.13: hi nāma te bhikkhave moghapurisā tiṇṇaṃ cīvarānaṃ aññataraṃ cīvaraṃ antaraghare nikkhipitvā atirekachārattaṃ vippavasissanti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np29:1.2.14: n' etaṃ bhikkhave appasannānaṃ vā pasādāya --pa--,
pli-tv-bu-vb-np29:1.2.15: evañ ca pana bhikkhave imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddiseyyātha:
pli-tv-bu-vb-np29:1.2.16.1: upavassaṃ kho pana kattikapuṇṇamaṃ yāni kho pana tāni āraññakāni senāsanāni sāsaṅkasammatāni sappaṭibhayāni tathārūpesu bhikkhu senāsanesu viharanto ākaṅkhamāno tiṇṇaṃ cīvarānaṃ aññataraṃ cīvaraṃ antaraghare nikkhipeyya, siyā ca tassa bhikkhuno kocid eva paccayo tena cīvarena vippavāsāya,
pli-tv-bu-vb-np29:1.2.17: chārattaparamaṃ tena bhikkhunā tena cīvarena vippavasitabbaṃ. tato ce uttariṃ vippavaseyya aññatra bhikkhusammutiyā, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyan ti. ||2||1||
pli-tv-bu-vb-np29:2.5: yāni kho pana tāni āraññakāni senāsanānīti,
pli-tv-bu-vb-np29:2.9: ārāme ārāmūpacāre corānaṃ niviṭṭhokāso dissati ṭhitokāso dissati nisinnokāso dissati nipannokāso dissati.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np29:2.11: ārāme ārāmūpacāre corehi manussā hatā dissanti viluttā dissanti ākoṭitā dissanti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np29:2.17: saṃghāṭiṃ vā uttarāsaṅgaṃ vā antaravāsakaṃ vā.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np29:2.20: siyā ca tassa bhikkhuno kocid eva paccayo tena cīvarena vippavāsāyā 'ti,
pli-tv-bu-vb-np29:2.22: chārattaparamaṃ tena bhikkhunā tena cīvarena vippavasitabban ti,
pli-tv-bu-vb-np29:2.31: idaṃ me bhante cīvaraṃ atirekachārattaṃ vippavutthaṃ aññatra bhikkhusammutiyā nissaggiyaṃ,
pli-tv-bu-vb-np29:2.36.1: atirekachāratte atirekasaññī vippavasati aññatra bhikkhusammutiyā, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np29:2.37: atirekachāratte vematiko vippavasati aññatra bhikkhusammutiyā, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np29:2.38: atirekachāratte ūnakasaññī vippavasati aññatra bhikkhusammutiyā, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np29:2.44: avilutte viluttasaññī vippavasati aññatra bhikkhusammutiyā, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np29:2.45: nissaggiyaṃ cīvaraṃ anissajjitvā paribhuñjati, āpatti dukkaṭassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np29:2.52: chārattaṃ vippavasitvā puna gāmasīmaṃ okkamitvā vasitvā pakkamati,
pli-tv-bu-vb-np29:2.53: anto chārattaṃ paccuddharati vissajjeti nassati vinassati ḍayhati acchinditvā gaṇhanti vissāsaṃ gaṇhanti,
